fact: The revenue authority's Msonkho Online system lets taxpayers register, file and pay online, per Nyasa Times reporting on the revenue authority's September 2019 MoU.
The revenue authority's director general says Malawian taxpayers will require a national ID to register and be issued a TPIN.

The Tax Administration (Electronic System) Rules, 2025, made 4 August 2025 by the Commissioner General, require taxpayers to be registered electronically and the Commissioner General to keep an electronic register of taxpayers.
